newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungagent buys stake in packaging company.
newsitem.headline: Hungagent buys stake in packaging company.

text.p: Hungarian trading company Hungagent Rt acquired a 40 percent stake in Hungarian paper packaging company Kartonpack Dobozipari Rt, Hungagent's Finance Director Gabriella Kajtar told Reuters.
"We signed the agreement and we are going to pay the purchase price," Kajtar said, but declined to release details.
The acquired stake represents a nominal 40.4 million forints of Kartonpack's 101 million forints issued share capital.
Kajtar said Hungagent bought the minority stake following an earlier decision to spend revenues from its recent capital increase partly to repay loans and partly to widen its activities.
Hungagent doubled its issued share capital to 448 million forints earlier this year via a private share issue.
Kartonpack is based in Debrecen, east Hungary, and is involved in manufacturing paper packaging materials for pharmaceuticals companies, Kajtar said.

She added Kartonpack's after-tax profit and sales had grown steadily over the last few years. In 1996 after-tax profits reached 53 million forints ($276,000) while sales amounted to 542 million forints, including seven million forints of exports, she said.
-- Emese Bartha, Budapest newsroom +36 1 327-4040 ($ = 192 Hungarian Forints)
